info.title: API.SH: Harbor Freight
info.description: The Harbor Freight API from API.SH: public Harbor Freight data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Harbor Freight's category tree: without a category, the top departments with two levels of subcategories; with a category, that category (description, breadcrumbs, featured brands) and its subcategories three levels deep. Each category: id, name, path, link, level, product count and position.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harborfreight-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Harbor Freight product with the site's sort orders and filters (star rating, review topic, text search): id, title, text, star rating, date, purchase date, reviewer nickname, incentivized flag, helpful and not-helpful votes, the reviewer's answers to the site's questions (would recommend, what they like), photos and Harbor Freight's responses, plus `raw`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harborfreight-reviews

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Only reviews tagged with this topic value id (from `review_topics` of /harborfreight/v1/product).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

answers.question: What I like about this product
What I like about this product

get.description:
Search Harbor Freight's catalog by keywords and/or a category, with every filter the shop offers: brand, availability (available nearby, in store only, online exclusive), minimum star rating, price range and any other facet the search returns (battery voltage, shank size, ...) through `filters`, in six sort orders. Each product: id, SKU, name, link, brand, price, regular price, sale price and end date, clearance flag, the current coupon and the Inside Track Club member deal (code, price, expiry, limit), the compare-to brand and price, category, sales channel, in-store-only and online-only flags, badges, images and the variants of a product family, plus `raw`. Also returns the facets with their values and counts, matching categories, a corrected query and the redirect link when the site sends a keyword to a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harborfreight-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path (power-tools/drills-drivers.html), its link, or its numeric id (from /harborfreight/v1/categories or `categories` in a search).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name, comma list = any of (values in `facets` brand).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other facet as name:value, several values with | and several facets with ; (e.g. Battery Voltage:20V|12V;more_ways_to_shop:New). Names and values as `facets` shows them; a value like 10_50 is a range.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default best_match). member_price_* sorts by the Inside Track Club price.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
In-store availability of up to 20 items: per store and item the stock status (in stock, limited stock, out of stock), the site's message, the aisle, a nearby store that has it, and the store's details. Ask for specific stores (store numbers) or for the stores around a ZIP code, city or coordinates, nearest first. Also returns when the inventory was last updated.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harborfreight-stock

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: ZIP code, city or state: the stores around it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Harbor Freight store by store number: name, address, phone, coordinates, status, opening date, opening hours, and the nearby stores with their distance.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harborfreight-store

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Harbor Freight stores near a ZIP code, city or state, or near coordinates, nearest first: store number, name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, status, opening date and opening hours, plus the store page link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harborfreight-stores

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: ZIP code, city or state. Or pass lat and lng.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles (site default when omitted).

parameters.name: open_only
parameters.description: false also returns stores that are not open yet (default true).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
